description: This file defines functions, types, and constants for configuring and performing web searches using the XAI search endpoint, including payload construction and request handling.

methods.name: resolveXaiXSearchConfig
methods.description: Coerces a configuration object into an XaiXSearchConfig type.

methods.name: resolveXaiXSearchModel
methods.description: Resolves the search model from configuration, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: resolveXaiXSearchInlineCitations
methods.description: Determines if inline citations are enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveXaiXSearchMaxTurns
methods.description: Resolves the maximum number of turns from configuration.

methods.name: buildXSearchTool
methods.description: Builds a search tool configuration object from options.

methods.name: buildXaiXSearchPayload
methods.description: Constructs the payload for an XAI web search request.

methods.name: requestXaiXSearch
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous web search request using provided parameters.
